pages.text: $(thing)Dairy$() is a $(l:getting_started/food_and_water#nutrients)Nutrient$() obtained from the milk produced by $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#dairy_animals)Dairy Animals$(). It can be drank, or processed into $(thing)Cheese$(). Drinking can be done out of a jug, and always restores $(l:getting_started/food_and_water#thirst)Thirst$(). However, it only adds to nutrition when drank after eating a food. Practically, this means that drinking milk twice in a row is ineffectual. A meal must precede it.
